check_api: Check that your Railway API is running and VITE_API_URL is set
press_build: Press "Build Snapshot" in the sidebar to load your portfolio
tooltip_portfolio_value: Total current market value of all assets in your portfolio, converted to ILS. Calculated by the snapshot engine using latest valuations, prices × quantities, and FX rates.
tooltip_profit_loss: Total gain or loss in ILS: current portfolio value minus total invested capital (cost basis). The percentage is return ÷ total invested.
tooltip_net_equity: Portfolio value minus all liabilities (mortgages, loans). This is your actual net worth from this portfolio. Debt shown is the outstanding loan balance on leveraged assets like real estate.
tooltip_total_invested: Total capital you have invested — the sum of all purchase costs, deposits, and BUY transactions across all assets. This is your cost basis used to calculate P&L.
